# Shipping policy (revised 1 August 2022)

Orders ship within two business days. A shipment is late when it arrives more than two days after the promised date;
a late shipment earns the account a credit of 5 percent of the order. Credits are approved by the regional manager
and recorded by the operations lead, Marcus Lindqvist.

Carriers: UPS for the Northeast and Mountain regions, FedEx for the South. Pallet shipments to the Eastern Promenade
Hotel and other hotel accounts go out on Mondays.
